messages:
Martha (Sales): Heads-up — AcmeHealth needs signatures by EOD Friday. They prefer a single envelope with MSA + Order Form. Can we stage signatures so we countersign the OF first and hold the MSA for legal review?
Eli (Legal): We can allow OF countersign but only if the OF expressly references the MSA version and states it doesn’t modify it. If they send MSA redlines, we'll need review time. What’s the urgency?
Martha (Sales): They need test credits to start a 2-week POC (committed). Finance requires a signed document or PO to release credits. Sam, can Finance approve OF-only for POC credits?
Sam (Finance): Yes for POC credits if OF includes pricing, term, and PO number. Standard payment: Net30. If they request Net45 that needs supervisor approval. Note: customer asks for KMS/HSM language — may affect Dedicated billing.
Raj (SE): Tech note: AcmeHealth expects HSM-backed keys for model logging. In their security questionnaire they flagged key management and data residency. Need to confirm BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys.
Ava (Security): We can provide SOC2 report plus standard KMS language. BYOK/HSM requires Dedicated or Private deployment and a provisioning SOW. Need confirmation whether they expect Redwood to hold keys.
Martha (Sales): @Eli — can Legal approve a short clause in the OF: "POC access granted subject to pending MSA review" and include a KMS preference checkbox? If so, we can send DocuSign.
Eli (Legal): We can add conditional language but must avoid contradictions. Suggest wording: "Customer acknowledges POC access is provided subject to execution of the MSA; this OF does not modify the MSA." Also push back on unlimited liability and indemnity cap.
Martha (Sales): Customer redlined indemnity cap higher than we accept. Can we propose mutual cap of $1,000,000 for the POC?
Eli (Legal): Propose alternative: mutual cap equal to fees paid in prior 12 months or $1,000,000, whichever is greater. I'll prepare a one-paragraph buffer.
Sam (Finance): For invoicing: they can issue a PO for the POC credits, we'll invoice Net30; Net45 needs manager sign-off. If KMS/HSM adds Dedicated fees, we'll include that in commercial OF.
Raj (SE): Operational note: enabling HSM BYOK in Dedicated must be configured at provisioning and takes ~3 business days + SOW. Can POC start on Hosted while we provision Dedicated? Hosted can't provide BYOK/HSM.
Martha (Sales): I'll confirm with the customer. If they accept Hosted for initial POC, we'll enable prefix caching and log minimization.
Ava (Security): For the security questionnaire, we will return answers, attach SOC2, and clarify KMS options. I'll prepare the SQ response doc.
Martha (Sales): Plan: 1) Send OF-only DocuSign with conditional clause, PO number, pricing, Net30 terms, and KMS checkbox; 2) Attach SOC2 + completed SQ; 3) Ask customer whether BYOK/HSM required now vs post-POC; 4) Legal to handle indemnity/MSA redlines.
Eli (Legal): I'll draft the MSA buffer language and a short indemnity counter-proposal.
Martha (Sales): Draft OF snippet for DocuSign (please edit):
```
Order Form (POC)
Customer: AcmeHealth
Term: 14-day POC starting on activation
Credits: 5,000 test token credits
Price: Trial credits provided at no charge for POC; commercial usage requires executed MSA or separate commercial OF
Payment Terms: Net30
PO Number: __________________
KMS required: [ ] Yes [ ] No (if yes, indicate BYOK/HSM and we will follow provisioning SOW)
Signature: Customer Signature -> Redwood countersign
```
Martha (Sales): @Eli @Ava quick review?
Eli (Legal): Change Price line to include explicit MSA dependency and add: "This OF does not supersede or modify the MSA." Approve otherwise.
Ava (Security): Add: "KMS options: Redwood-managed keys (default) or dedicated HSM/BYOK (requires Dedicated/Private deployment and provisioning SOW)." And attach SOC2 link.
Martha (Sales): Great. I'll assemble the envelope. @esign-bot create envelope with OF + SOC2 attestation and route to customer then Eli for countersign.
esign-bot: Envelope created: envelope_id=env_20260322_02. Sent to customer email on file; reminder set for 48h.
Sam (Finance): Once executed, open invoice request with PO attached and I'll fast-track Net30.
Raj (SE): If customer confirms BYOK now, loop me to kick off provisioning. Otherwise we'll begin Hosted POC config.
Martha (Sales): Thanks all — will update after customer response. :rocket:
